title: Why do we need to eat?
examples: Teacher, why do we need to eat food every day?
What happens if we do not eat for a long time?
Does food help us run and play?

explain.say: Food gives our bodies the power to move.

draw.text: Why do we need to eat?
Food gives us energy to move.

explain.say: When we eat, our bodies get the fuel for playing.
Food helps us get bigger and stronger every day.

draw.text: Food helps us grow big and strong.

explain.say: Good food keeps our bodies from getting sick.
Eating a balanced meal helps us do everything we need.

draw.text: Eat a balanced meal every day.

explain.say: When we eat vegetables, we get vitamins to stay well.

draw.text: Vitamins keep us from getting sick.

faq.q: Why do we need to eat food?
faq.a: We need food for energy to play and for building strong bodies. Food also helps keep us from getting sick.
asks: What is the purpose of eating?
Why is food important for kids?

faq.a: Food gives us the energy we need to run, jump, and learn new things. Eating regular meals keeps this energy up.
asks: Where does our running power come from?
Is food like a battery for us?

faq.a: Yes, eating foods with protein and calcium helps our bones and muscles grow bigger and stronger. This is important when you are learning.
Vitamins are special things in food that help our bodies fight off germs and stay healthy. They help us feel good all the time.
asks: What stops us from getting sick?
What is the job of vitamins?

faq.a: A balanced meal means eating different kinds of food like fruits, vegetables, and proteins. This gives your body all the things it needs to work well.
asks: What should I eat at lunch?
How many food groups do I need?

facts: Food provides the energy needed for all our daily activities.
Protein in food helps our bodies build and repair tissues.
Vitamins found in fruits and vegetables help keep us healthy.
Eating a variety of foods helps us grow strong.

quiz.say: If you want to run very fast, what do you need most from food?
quiz.why: Energy from food helps your muscles move quickly when you run.

wrong.0: Bones help you stand up, but energy helps you move fast.
wrong.1: Vitamins help you stay well, but energy helps you run.
wrong.2: Protein helps you grow, but energy helps you move right now.

quiz.say: Which food group helps you grow big and strong?
quiz.why: Protein is the building block that helps your body get bigger and stronger.

wrong.0: These are great for vitamins, but protein is better for building.
wrong.1: Water is important, but it does not contain the building blocks for muscle.
wrong.3: Sweets give quick energy but not enough for growing bones.

quiz.say: If you are sick, what does food help you do?
quiz.why: Vitamins and minerals in food help your body fight off any germs that try to make you sick.

wrong.1: Food does not make you sleep; rest does that.
wrong.2: While food helps running, its main job when sick is fighting germs.
wrong.3: Getting bigger is about growth, but fighting germs is the key when you are unwell.
